pr_title: Add default configuration and logging to CreateSlimBuilder
pr_body:
# Add default configuration and logging to CreateSlimBuilder

Update slim builder to include:
- JSON file configuration for appsettings.json and appsettings.{EnvironmentName}.json
- UserSecrets configuration
- Console logging
- Logging configuration

This adds back some app size to the api template app. But it is worth the tradeoff given users expect these things to work out of the box.

Update api template with appsettings files and remove AddConsole

Fix #47598

issue_context.title: Add JSON file and UserSecrets configuration providers, and console logging w/ configuration to CreateSlimBuilder
comments:
FYI - with the latest builds, here are the numbers I'm seeing with this proposed change:

### Windows 
**Current:**  7.46 MB (7,832,576 bytes)
**Proposed:** 8.53 MB (8,946,688 bytes)

### Linux
**Current:**  8.01 MB (8,406,520 bytes)
**Proposed:** 9.20 MB (9,657,968 bytes)

So this change will add back ~1.1-1.2 MB of app size. I still think it is worth the tradeoff, but just wanted to list it here.

review_comments: I assume the decision to include the simple logger by default in the slim builder vs. the more robust console logger that's currently in `Program.cs` is intentional to reduce app size?

It will reduce app size, eventually, once we fix SimpleConsole to not include JSON and Systemd formatters as well. I still need to log that bug in dotnet/runtime. As the code exists today in dotnet/runtime, the behavior is exactly the same between AddSimpleConsole() and AddConsole(). But I want SlimBuilder to just use the Simple format by default, and the app dev to explicitly opt-in to the other format(s) through code. My initial investigation was that this would save ~120KB
I've opened https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/85116 for this size work.
